speaker: Narrator
text: A thin white dog trots up the ferry ramp, a stray none of them has seen before.

speaker: Mira
text: "That is not Ash," Mira says. "Ash is old and grey and asleep by the stove at home. And it is not Tobin's Pip either."

speaker: Wren
text: "Then we call the stray Burr," Wren says, and lifts the white dog onto the ferry.
